rows.note: Use this all-purpose choice for a subject or practice that few people know about, rather than one that is simply mysterious.

example.english: This craft is arcane, and not many people know it.
example.traditional: 呢門手藝太冷門，識得嘅人唔多。
example.jyutping: ni1 mun4 sau2 ngai6 taai3 laang5 mun2 sik1 dak1 ge3 jan4 m4 do1

rows.note: Use this when the material is difficult to understand and only specialists can follow it.

example.english: This book on quantum physics is so arcane that I can't make head or tail of it.
example.traditional: 呢本書講量子物理，內容太深奧，我睇到一頭霧水。
example.jyutping: ne1 bun2 syu1 gong2 loeng6 zi2 mat6 lei5 noi6 jung4 taai3 sam1 ou3 ngo5 tai2 dou3 jat1 tau4 mou6 seoi2

rows.note: Use this when “arcane” stresses secrecy or an air of mystery rather than specialist difficulty.

example.english: They used arcane codes to pass messages, and outsiders had no idea what they meant.
example.traditional: 佢哋用神秘嘅暗號傳話，外人完全唔明。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jung6 san4 bei3 ge3 am3 hou6 cyun4 waa6 ngoi6 jan4 jyun4 cyun4 m4 ming4
